questions.cardText:
[Zoology] Why do some birds have a larger hippocampus in the fall?
A. To improve mating calls
B. To hide from predators more effectively
C. To find stored food
Answer: C. This seasonal change in the hippocampus is similar to how London taxi drivers have been found to develop larger hippocampi due to the extensive spatial navigation required in their jobs. This brain region is associated with memory and navigation, demonstrating its importance across different species for similar cognitive tasks.
questions.de: Futter versteckende Vögel wie die Schwarzkopfmeise haben im Herbst einen größeren Hippocampus – wobei hilft er ihnen?
questions.en: Food-caching birds such as the black-capped chickadee grow a larger hippocampus in autumn — what does it help them do?

timeline.labelEn: Carl Linnaeus names the black-capped chickadee in the 12th edition of Systema Naturae
timeline.labelDe: Carl Linné benennt die Schwarzkopfmeise in der 12. Auflage seiner Systema Naturae

questions.notes: Confirmed: the chickadee's hippocampus grows during the caching season, largest in October, believed to help it remember cache locations (Wikipedia).

questions.cardText:
[Earth Science] What is the Earth’s inner core primarily composed of?
A. Granite and basalt
B. Carbon and silicates
C. Iron and nickel
Answer: C.
questions.de: Woraus besteht der innere Erdkern hauptsächlich?
questions.en: What is the Earth's inner core primarily composed of?

timeline.labelEn: Inge Lehmann discovers that Earth has a solid inner core
timeline.labelDe: Inge Lehmann entdeckt, dass die Erde einen festen inneren Kern hat

questions.notes: Confirmed: a solid ball of iron–nickel alloy with some lighter elements (Wikipedia).
